contexts.text: Concerning Javan: The sons of Judah and the sons of Jerusalem ye have sold to the sons of the Javanites, that ye may remove them far from their border ()... The sons of the Javanites = worship in externals separated from what is internal. (Compare this with AE 1194, under Greece.)

Javan, and Tubal stand for true external worship itself, in ; where it treats of the Lord's Kingdom and His Advent. Tubal, and Javan = those who are in external worship corresponding to internal, who are to be instructed concerning internal things.
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech (), as before, = various rites representative or corresponding.
By the sons of Javan () are signified others still who had external worship derived from the worship which was with the nation Javan.

Elishah, Tarshish, Chittim, and Dodanim (the sons of Javan) AC 1158 were so many nations with whom there was such worship, and by which are signified so many doctrinals, which were rituals, derived from the external worship with Javan. Illustrated.

As by the isles are signified the things which are more remote, therefore also Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, and Javan, by which are signified the external things of worship, are called isles. Illustrated.
By Dan and Javan () are signified those who are in the Knowledges of celestial things.
By Javan, Tubal, and Meshech are signified those who are in external worship.
By the sons of Javan () are signified external truths.
By Javan and Tubal is signified external representative worship.
